tasks.label: Run Ufuq OS in QEMU (Graphics)
tasks.command: C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe -kernel C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf -initrd C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf -m 256M -vga std -serial file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log -display sdl -no-reboot

tasks.label: Verify Disk Entry
tasks.command: $content = Get-Content 'c:\s_lang\s-programming-language\أفق\نقطة_الدخول.ص' -Encoding UTF8; $lineNum = 0; foreach($line in $content) { $lineNum++; if($lineNum -ge 531 -and $lineNum -le 555) { Write-Host "$lineNum`: $line" } }

tasks.label: QEMU Fresh Run
tasks.command: $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot') -PassThru | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "QEMU PID: $($_.Id)"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 18; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-String '\[DB\]|\[FB\]|BGA|مرحلة 9|الخط|مزدوج|شعار|الشاشة' | Select-Object -First 30 }

tasks.label: QEMU Debug Run
tasks.command: $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 25; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-String '\[LOGO\]|\[DB\]|\[FB\]' | Select-Object -First 20

tasks.label: QEMU P9 Debug
tasks.command: $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-String '\[P9\]|\[LOGO\]|\[DB\]' | Select-Object -First 20

tasks.label: Check QEMU
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, CPU, WorkingSet64 | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Kill QEMU + Check IR
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host 'All QEMU killed'; Select-String -Path 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_ir_temp\entry_main.ll' -Pattern 'fill_rect|fb_set_pixel' | Select-Object -First 10

tasks.label: Find fill_rect in HAL
tasks.command: $halFile = Get-ChildItem 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_ir_temp\' -Filter '*hal_hal*'; Select-String -Path $halFile.FullName -Pattern 'define.*fb_fill_rect' | Select-Object LineNumber, Line | Select-Object -First 3

tasks.label: QEMU Minimal DB Test
tasks.command: $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 20; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-String '\[P9\]|\[DB\]|مرحلة 9' | Select-Object -First 10

tasks.label: Check Log
tasks.command: if(Test-Path 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'){$sz = (Get-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log').Length; Write-Host "Log size: $sz bytes"; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 15} else {Write-Host 'No log file!'}

tasks.label: QEMU 64MB Heap
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 25; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 25

tasks.label: QEMU Final DB Test
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; $serial = 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log'; if(Test-Path $serial){Remove-Item $serial -Force}; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList @('-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'); Start-Sleep -Seconds 25; Get-Content $serial -Encoding UTF8 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 30

tasks.label: QEMU Test Optimized
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\temp_hal\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'; Start-Sleep 25; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

tasks.label: Read Serial Extended
tasks.command: Start-Sleep 15; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG (extended) ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

tasks.label: Check QEMU Status
tasks.command: $proc = Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($proc) { Write-Host "QEMU alive: PID=$($proc.Id) CPU=$($proc.CPU)" } else { Write-Host 'QEMU NOT running' }; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG SIZE ==='; $f = Get-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue; if ($f) { Write-Host "Size: $($f.Length) bytes"; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' } else { Write-Host 'No log file' }

tasks.label: QEMU Debug Run
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\temp_hal\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot','-no-shutdown'; Start-Sleep 40; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '=== QEMU STATUS ==='; $p = Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { Write-Host "ALIVE PID=$($p.Id)" } else { Write-Host 'DEAD' }

tasks.label: Read Full Serial
tasks.command: Write-Host '=== FULL SERIAL LOG ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

tasks.label: Stop QEMU
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Write-Host 'QEMU stopped'

tasks.label: QEMU Test Swap
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\temp_hal\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'; Start-Sleep 30; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 30

tasks.label: Check boot32 paths
tasks.command: Write-Host '=== boot32.elf locations ==='; @('C:\s_lang\temp_hal\boot32.elf','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf') | ForEach-Object { $f=Get-Item $_ -EA SilentlyContinue; if($f){Write-Host "$_ → $($f.Length) bytes, $($f.LastWriteTime)"} else {Write-Host "$_ → NOT FOUND"} }; Write-Host '=== QEMU alive? ==='; $p=Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Host "YES PID=$($p.Id)"}else{Write-Host 'NO'}

tasks.label: QEMU ufuq_build boot32
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'; Start-Sleep 30; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 30; Write-Host '=== QEMU? ==='; $p=Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Host 'ALIVE'}else{Write-Host 'DEAD'}

tasks.label: Wait and Read Log
tasks.command: Start-Sleep 20; Write-Host '=== FULL LOG (tail) ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 25; Write-Host '=== QEMU? ==='; $p=Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Host 'ALIVE'}else{Write-Host 'DEAD'}

tasks.label: QEMU Test Reverted
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'; Start-Sleep 35; Write-Host '=== SERIAL LOG (tail) ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 15; Write-Host '=== QEMU? ==='; $p=Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Host 'ALIVE'}else{Write-Host 'DEAD'}

tasks.label: QEMU Mouse Test
tasks.command: Get-Process qemu* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -Force -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Process 'C:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe' -ArgumentList '-kernel','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\boot32.elf','-initrd','C:\s_lang\ufuq_build\ufuq_kernel.elf','-m','256M','-vga','std','-serial','file:C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log','-display','sdl','-no-reboot'; Start-Sleep 40; Write-Host '=== LOG TAIL ==='; Get-Content 'C:\s_lang\ufuq_serial.log' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 20; Write-Host '=== QEMU ==='; $p=Get-Process qemu* -EA SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Host 'ALIVE'}else{Write-Host 'DEAD'}
